body.en: Angles, triangles and polygons, circles, and area, perimeter and volume.
Triangle angles sum to \( 180^{\circ} \); a polygon of \( n \) sides sums to \( (n-2)\cdot180^{\circ} \). Pythagoras \( a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2} \). Circle area \( \pi r^{2} \), circumference \( 2\pi r \).

caption.en: Parallel lines cut by a transversal. Alternate interior angles and corresponding angles are equal ($120^\circ$), while consecutive interior angles are supplementary ($120^\circ + 60^\circ = 180^\circ$).

body.en:
• Figures Are Not Necessarily to Scale: Never trust eye measurements on the ACT. An angle that looks like 90° is only 90° if marked with a square or proven with given equations.
  • The Triangle Inequality Theorem: The sum of any two sides must strictly exceed the third: \( a + b > c \). If two sides are \( 7 \) and \( 11 \), the third side \( x \) must satisfy \( 11 - 7 < x < 11 + 7 \Rightarrow 4 < x < 18 \).
  • Special Right Triangles (No Formula Sheet!): Memorize \( 30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ \) sides \( x : x\sqrt{3} : 2x \), and \( 45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ \) sides \( x : x : x\sqrt{2} \). Common Pythagorean triples include \( 3-4-5 \), \( 5-12-13 \), and \( 8-15-17 \).
  • Regular Polygon Angles: The sum of interior angles is \( (n-2)\cdot180^\circ \). Each interior angle of a regular \( n \)-gon is \( \frac{(n-2)\cdot180^\circ}{n} \), and each exterior angle is \( \frac{360^\circ}{n} \).
A right triangle has legs \( 9 \) and \( 12 \). Find the hypotenuse. \[ \sqrt{81+144}=15. \]
Find the interior-angle sum of a pentagon. \[ (5-2)\cdot180^{\circ}=540^{\circ}. \]

question.en: A cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. Find its total surface area.
Two sides of a non-degenerate triangle measure 7 inches and 11 inches. What is the range of possible perimeters for this triangle?

solution.en: Let \(x\) be the third side. By the Triangle Inequality Theorem, \(11 - 7 < x < 11 + 7 \Rightarrow 4 < x < 18\). The perimeter is \(P = 7 + 11 + x = 18 + x\). Substituting the bounds for \(x\): \(18 + 4 < P < 18 + 18 \Rightarrow 22 < P < 36\) inches.
